title: AI-assisted document drafting chat (ANDS dossier builder)
walkthrough:
You are inside a dossier's module workspace: a section tree on the left, a work panel in the centre, and a status rail on the right showing a progress bar (e.g. "required sections complete") and three gate flags — "Documents", "Fee", "Valid eCTD". In the tree, each section has a status glyph and badges: "req" or "opt", plus a "✦AI" badge on sections that support AI drafting (its tooltip reads "This section supports interactive AI drafting — you review and approve before anything is saved").

Clicking a section opens its panel: an eyebrow line ("Module … · Section …"), the section title, and a guidance box headed "What Health Canada needs here" with a link "Health Canada guidance ↗". Below sits an action bar with tabs "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A".

Choosing "✦ Author in-app" on an AI-enabled section reveals a mode toggle: "💬 Draft with AI" (default) versus "✦ Sample & edit". In AI mode you see the note "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft." An empty thread shows "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what [section title] needs." You type into a box with the placeholder "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example" and press "Send" (Enter also sends); the button reads "Thinking…" while the reply streams in as chat bubbles.

Once a reply finishes, a button "Use this draft →" appears ("Saving…" while it works). Clicking it saves the latest AI reply; a confirmation that it was "saved as an AI-assisted draft — provenance is recorded in the audit trail", telling you to use "Review vs Health Canada" under the "✦ Sample & edit" mode to check required elements before filing, is announced only via a visually-hidden screen-reader live region — on screen you simply see the saved document appear, and that review remains a separate step you must go find. The saved document then appears in the panel with filename, size, an md5 checksum prefix, a "Download" link, and a chip reading "AI-assisted — review before filing" (tooltip: "Drafted interactively with the AI assistant under your direction. Recorded in the audit trail. Review against the Health Canada guidance before filing.").

If the AI backend isn't configured, the chat shows "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Use the standard "Author" button below instead, or ask an admin to configure it." — the "Author" button it refers to is actually under the "✦ Sample & edit" mode, not below the chat.
